analysis.headline: Tesla and SpaceX form committees to review a possible merger
analysis.summary: Tesla and SpaceX have formed special committees made up of independent directors to review a possible merger between the two companies, Elon Musk said during SpaceX's third-quarter earnings call. Musk, who is not on either committee, said the committees were formed at shareholders' request and that he sees a lot of merit in combining the companies.
